Recorded session · live data, live model call

Two dashboards.
One recording. No mock data.

This is a real screen recording of Finance Advisors — both Streamlit apps running locally, fetching live prices from Yahoo Finance and FRED, and generating one narrative report via a live Anthropic API call. Nothing here is staged or faked.

The full session

0:00–1:24 · real-time
  1. market_insight_agent — Equities, Gold, Real Estate, and Macro & Rates tabs render live yfinance and FRED data, each with its own trend/momentum/valuation read.
  2. AI Insight tab — clicking “Generate / Regenerate report” fires a real request to Claude, which reasons over the full scorecard and recent headlines and writes an actual analyst-style report.
  3. History tab — the report just generated shows up immediately, downloadable as a PDF alongside every earlier run.
  4. workspace — the second, independent dashboard: Apple scored live on its own composite technical + fundamental model, PDF export included.
  5. Watchlist tab — four tickers scored and color-coded from Buy to Strong Sell in one pass.

84 seconds, unedited except for a hard trim at the start and end.
